Ukraine drone attacks hit Russia; Russia attacks Kyiv

Ukraine launched drone attacks targeting warehouses and an oil depot in Russia, with conflicting reports on casualties. Simultaneously, Russia conducted missile attacks on Kyiv, resulting in fatalities and injuries. These events occur amidst a "drone deal" between the EU and Ukraine aimed at boosting production.
